podcast.title: Feud with Oasis
podcast.body: Kele Okereke engaged in a notable feud with the band Oasis, indicating his strong opinions within the music scene. "it was fun to watch Kelly's feud with Oasis. He really didn't know them in our regard."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Frontman of Bloc Party
podcast.body: Kele Okereke is the frontman of the British band Bloc Party. "Kelly O'Kareki, the frontman of the excellent British band Block Party."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Nigerian Heritage
podcast.body: Kele Okereke, whose full name is Rowland Kele Okereke, has parents of Nigerian descent. "Kelly's full name is Roland, Kelly Chouwu O'Kareki, both his parents and Igerian..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Breakthrough via Franz Ferdinand
xref.body: The band achieved its significant break around 2003 when frontman Kele Okereke gave a demo tape to Alex Kapranos, the singer of Franz Ferdinand, at one of their shows. "Block Party got their big break when Kelly went to a France Ferdinand show and gave a tape to singer Alex Capranos. That would be about 2003."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Kele Okereke's Feud
xref.body: Kele Okereke, frontman of Bloc Party, engaged in a public feud with Oasis, highlighting rivalries within the British music scene. "it was fun to watch Kelly's feud with Oasis. He really didn't know them in our regard."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Role in Bloc Party's Breakthrough
xref.body: Franz Ferdinand's singer, Alex Kapranos, played an unwitting role in Bloc Party's big break when Kele Okereke handed him a demo tape at a show around 2003. "Block Party got their big break when Kelly went to a France Ferdinand show and gave a tape to singer Alex Capranos. That would be about 2003."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
